title: Digital SAT Reading and Writing — Complete Course
summary: Every Reading and Writing question type on the Digital SAT, taught step by step with original examples, a practice quiz on every page and full timed practice tests.
meta_desc: Free complete Digital SAT Reading and Writing course: test overview, every question type, all grammar rules, transitions, rhetorical synthesis, and timed full-length practice tests with explanations.

intro_blocks.title: How to study for the Digital SAT here
items: 1 · Open a lesson tile and study the rules and worked examples.
2 · Do the short quiz at the end of the lesson, then open its practice page: Practice 1 and 2 (Foundation), 3 and 4 (Exam level), 5 (Challenge). Every answer choice is explained.
3 · Aim for 80% or more in every set. Your best score is saved on this device, and the lesson tile shows your progress.
4 · When most topics are done, take a full practice test with the timer on, then review every explanation and go back to your weakest topics.

intro_blocks.title: خطة المذاكرة باختصار
items: ادخل على الدرس وذاكر القاعدة والأمثلة.
حل الكويز اللي في آخر الدرس، وبعدين صفحة التدريبات: من Practice 1 لحد Practice 5 — كل اختيار مشروح ليه صح وليه غلط.
هدفك 80% أو أكتر في كل تدريب. أحسن نتيجة بتتحفظ على جهازك، ومربع الدرس بيوريك وصلت لفين.
لما تخلص أغلب الدروس، حل امتحان كامل بالوقت، وراجع الشرح كله وارجع لأضعف الدروس.
